hypothesis: emit a dot only while its field-based marginal kernel credit exceeds alpha*DTI/(1-alpha*DTI) (emitter.py lazy greedy), hard cap 60,000; drop uncredited mass to raise credit per dot.
mechanism: exact marginal-gain theorem of metric.py; the alpha false-positive tax is only paid on dots whose expected kernel proximity pays for it.
named_non_fault_mimic: same as H85-1: alluvial-fan margins / Lahontan shorelines, acquisition seams, volcanic mesa/flow margins (unchanged field).
layers: same geopb_crest field as H85-1 (10-band whitened step statistic, 2-of-3 domains); no new layers.
difference_from_repo: existing pipeline emits exactly n top dots; this experiment gates emission on the metric's own marginal bar. Packing lever only -- no new field, no new data.
leakage_canary: not rerun: emission mask uses per-fold visible faults only; field unchanged from H85-1 (canary AUC 0.5036).
